html:
From housing developments to major infrastructure projects, steel and metal products form the backbone of Canada’s growth. For decades, Dass Metal Products, a division of JDass Group, has been at the forefront of supplying high-quality, certified materials that builders and developers can trust. Backed by a strong leadership team and a commitment to innovation, Dass Metal Products continues to play a vital role in shaping Ontario’s construction landscape.

Products That Builders Trust

At Dass Metal Products, quality is more than a promise — it’s a standard. The company’s 300,000 sq. ft. Steel Service Centre in Vaughan produces a wide range of products designed for strength, durability, and reliability.

Key offerings include:

  • Steel Framing Systems – Certified solutions used in residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
  • Custom Fabrication – Tailored steel products designed to meet the unique specifications of contractors and developers.
  • Structural Products – Reliable materials that serve as the foundation for everything from housing complexes to provincial infrastructure.

With CSSBI certification, Dass Metal Products guarantees that every product meets rigorous Canadian standards. This commitment has earned the trust of contractors, engineers, and government partners across Ontario.

Powered by Innovation and Sustainability

The Vaughan facility is powered by district energy systems, reflecting Dass Metal Products’ dedication to efficiency and sustainability. By reducing environmental impact and improving energy performance, the company aligns its operations with Canada’s green building priorities.

“Our products don’t just build stronger structures,” says COO Preet Dass. “They build a cleaner, more sustainable future for our communities.”

The Leadership Behind the Brand

Dass Metal Products is more than just a steel supplier — it is guided by a leadership team that ensures every aspect of the business is aligned with JDass Group’s broader vision of sustainable growth and Canada-first values.

  • Jaswant Dass (CEO, JDass Group) – Provides visionary leadership, ensuring diversification and long-term resilience across industries.
  • Navjot Dass (Managing Director, JDass Group) – Oversees strategic growth, compliance, and certifications like CSSBI approval.
  • Preet Dass (COO, JDass Group) – Drives operational excellence, ensuring that Dass Metal Products delivers quality and reliability at scale.

Together, this team ensures that Dass Metal Products remains a trusted partner in Canada’s construction and infrastructure sectors.

Supporting Ontario’s Growth

With Ontario making historic investments in housing and infrastructure, demand for certified steel products continues to grow. Dass Metal Products is proud to contribute to these efforts by:

  • Supporting local contractors with reliable supply.
  • Partnering on large-scale government projects.
  • Expanding capacity to meet the province’s future needs.

By combining innovation, sustainability, and strong leadership, Dass Metal Products remains committed to building Canada’s future one project at a time.

About Dass Metal Products

Dass Metal Products, headquartered in Vaughan, Ontario, is a division of JDass Group. With state-of-the-art facilities and certified steel solutions, the company supplies builders and developers across Ontario. Guided by Jaswant Dass (CEO), Navjot Dass (Managing Director), and Preet Dass (COO), Dass Metal Products delivers quality, innovation, and Canada-first leadership in every project.
